 function renderTree(v){
  const nodes=v.nodes||[],edges=v.edges||[],parents=new Set(edges.map(e=>e.to));let roots=nodes.filter(n=>!parents.has(n.id));if(!roots.length)roots=nodes.slice(0,1);const seen=new Set();
  function nodeHTML(node){if(seen.has(node.id))return '';seen.add(node.id);const children=edges.filter(e=>e.from===node.id).map(edge=>({edge,node:nodes.find(n=>n.id===edge.to)})).filter(x=>x.node);const kind=node.kind||'outcome';return '<li class="tree-branch"><div class="tree-node '+esc(kind)+(node.changed?' changed':'')+'" data-node="'+esc(node.id)+'"><span class="node-kind">'+esc(kind==='decision'?'□ Decision':kind==='chance'?'○ Uncertainty':kind==='continuation'?'Branch continues':'△ Outcome')+'</span><strong>'+esc(node.label)+'</strong>'+(node.value!==undefined?'<span class="node-value">'+esc(node.value)+(node.unit?' '+esc(node.unit):'')+'</span>':'')+'</div>'+(children.length?'<ul>'+children.map(({edge,node})=>'<li class="tree-edge '+(edge.changed?'changed':'')+'"><span class="edge-label">'+esc(edge.label||'')+'</span><ul>'+nodeHTML(node)+'</ul></li>').join('')+'</ul>':'')+'</li>';}
  return '<div class="dm-tree" role="group" aria-label="'+esc(v.heading)+'" data-stage="'+esc(v.stage||'structure')+'"><ul>'+roots.map(nodeHTML).join('')+'</ul></div>';
 }
 function renderDrawing(){
  const v=STEPS[index].visual;$('scenario').textContent=v.heading;$('assumption').textContent=v.assumption;$('readout').textContent=v.readout;$('visual-note').textContent=v.note||'Generated teaching illustration. Source references are shown below.';
  let items=v.items;if(!Array.isArray(items))items=[v.before,v.after].filter(Boolean).map((item,i)=>typeof item==='object'?{...item,label:item.label||(i?'After':'Before'),changed:i===1}:({label:i?'After':'Before',value:item,changed:i===1}));
  let drawing='';if(v.type==='decision-tree'||v.type==='tree'){drawing=renderTree(v);if(items.length)drawing+='<div class="dm-grid" style="--item-count:'+Math.min(3,items.length)+'">'+items.map(itemHTML).join('')+'</div>';}else if((['sequence','timeline'].includes(v.type)||(v.type==='comparison'&&items.length<=2)))drawing='<div class="dm-sequence">'+items.map((item,i)=>(i?'<span class="dm-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>':'')+itemHTML(item)).join('')+'</div>';else drawing='<div class="dm-grid" style="--item-count:'+Math.min(3,Math.max(1,items.length))+'">'+items.map(itemHTML).join('')+'</div>';
  if(v.equation)drawing+='<div class="dm-equation">'+esc(v.equation)+'</div>';if(v.calculation)drawing+='<div class="dm-calculation"><strong>Current calculation</strong><p>'+esc(v.calculation)+'</p></div>';
  $('drawing').innerHTML='<div class="dm-figure">'+drawing+'</div>';
 }
 function renderQuiz(){
  const step=STEPS[index],q=step.quiz,box=$('quiz');box.hidden=!q;if(!q){box.innerHTML='';return;}let answer=answers[step.id];if(answer&&(!Number.isInteger(answer.choice)||answer.choice<0||answer.choice>=q.choices.length)){delete answers[step.id];answer=null;}
  box.innerHTML='<p class="practice-label">Generated practice · Not an assessment</p><h2>'+esc(q.question)+'</h2><div class="choices">'+q.choices.map((text,i)=>'<button type="button" class="choice '+(answer?.choice===i?(i===q.correct?'correct':'needs-rethink'):'')+'" data-choice="'+i+'" aria-pressed="'+(answer?.choice===i)+'"><span class="choice-letter">'+String.fromCharCode(65+i)+'</span><span>'+esc(text)+'</span></button>').join('')+'</div>'+(answer?'<div class="feedback '+(answer.choice===q.correct?'':'retry')+'"><strong>'+(answer.revealed?'Answer explained. ':answer.choice===q.correct?'That reasoning works. ':'Try this reasoning. ')+'</strong><span id="feedback-text">'+esc(q.explanations[answer.choice])+'</span><div class="dm-inline-audio feedback-controls"><button id="read-feedback" type="button">🔊 Read explanation</button><button id="replay-feedback" type="button">Replay explanation</button></div><details class="audio-transcript"><summary>Feedback audio transcript</summary><p id="feedback-transcript"></p></details></div>':'')+'<div class="quiz-options"><button id="retry-question" type="button">Try again</button><button id="show-answer" type="button">Show explanation</button></div>';
  box.querySelectorAll('[data-choice]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{stopAudio();const choice=Number(button.dataset.choice);answers[step.id]={choice,correct:choice===q.correct};save();renderQuiz();updateNav();paintAudio();announce(choice===q.correct?'Answer explained. Next is available.':'Read the explanation, then try again or show the explanation.');}));
  $('retry-question').addEventListener('click',()=>{stopAudio();delete answers[step.id];save();renderQuiz();updateNav();paintAudio();});$('show-answer').addEventListener('click',()=>{stopAudio();answers[step.id]={choice:q.correct,correct:true,revealed:true};save();renderQuiz();updateNav();paintAudio();});if(answer){$('read-feedback').addEventListener('click',()=>play(feedbackId()));$('replay-feedback').addEventListener('click',()=>play(feedbackId(),true));}
 }
 function paintCompletion(){readCompletion();const yes=!!completed[String(MODULE)];$('mark-complete').hidden=yes;$('undo-complete').hidden=!yes;$('completion-status').textContent=!storage?'Browser storage is unavailable; completion may not be saved.':yes?'✓ Completed viewing. You can undo this choice.':'Completion is saved only when you choose Mark complete.';}
 function updateNav(){const step=STEPS[index],locked=!!step.quiz&&answers[step.id]?.choice!==step.quiz.correct;$('back').disabled=index===0;$('next').disabled=locked;$('next').textContent=index===STEPS.length-1?'Review from start ↺':'Next →';$('next-hint').textContent=locked?'Choose the correct reasoning or show the explanation.':'';}
 function render(focus=false){
  stopAudio();const step=STEPS[index];$('chapter').textContent=step.chapter+' / '+CHAPTERS.length+' · '+step.chapterTitle;$('count').textContent='Step '+(index+1)+' of '+STEPS.length;$('step-type').textContent=step.quiz?'A short application check':'One idea at a time';$('title').textContent=step.title;$('explanation').textContent=step.body;$('takeaway').textContent=step.takeaway;$('step-source').textContent=Array.isArray(step.sources)?step.sources.join('; '):step.sources;$('explain-more').hidden=!step.more;$('explain-more').open=false;$('more-text').textContent=step.more||'';
  const p=$('progress');p.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',index+1);p.setAttribute('aria-valuemax',STEPS.length);p.setAttribute('aria-valuetext','Step '+(index+1)+' of '+STEPS.length);p.innerHTML=CHAPTERS.map((_,j)=>{const chapterSteps=STEPS.map((s,i)=>({s,i})).filter(x=>x.s.chapter===j+1),viewed=chapterSteps.filter(x=>x.i<=index).length;return '<div class="progress-segment"><span style="width:'+viewed/chapterSteps.length*100+'%"></span></div>';}).join('');
  renderQuiz();renderDrawing();paintAudio();updateNav();$('completion').hidden=index!==STEPS.length-1;$('lesson').dataset.lastStep=String(index===STEPS.length-1);paintCompletion();document.title=step.title+' · Decision Making Module '+MODULE+' · Alahmeds Study';audioMessage(DRAFT?'DRAFT ONLY. OpenAI recordings have not been packaged.':'Press Read this when you are ready. Nothing advances automatically.');save();announce('Step '+(index+1)+' · '+step.title+(!storage?'. Browser storage is unavailable.':''));if(focus){$('title').focus({preventScroll:true});if(innerWidth<=680)scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});}
 }
 function go(delta){if(delta>0&&$('next').disabled)return;index=index===STEPS.length-1&&delta>0?0:Math.max(0,Math.min(STEPS.length-1,index+delta));$('resume').hidden=true;render(true);}
 $('chapter-list').innerHTML=CHAPTERS.map((chapter,j)=>'<button type="button" class="chapter-jump" data-index="'+STEPS.findIndex(s=>s.chapter===j+1)+'"><span class="chapter-num">'+String(j+1).padStart(2,'0')+'</span><span>'+esc(chapter.title)+'</span></button>').join('');$('chapter-list').querySelectorAll('[data-index]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{index=Number(button.dataset.index);$('contents-dialog').close();$('resume').hidden=true;render(true);}));
 $('contents').addEventListener('click',()=>{stopAudio();$('contents-dialog').showModal();});$('close-contents').addEventListener('click',()=>$('contents-dialog').close());$('next').addEventListener('click',()=>go(1));$('back').addEventListener('click',()=>go(-1));$('replay').addEventListener('click',()=>{renderDrawing();announce('Drawing reviewed. This step stays open.');});$('restart').addEventListener('click',()=>{index=0;$('resume').hidden=true;render(true);});$('dismiss-resume').addEventListener('click',()=>$('resume').hidden=true);
 $('read-this').addEventListener('click',()=>play(mainId()));$('replay-audio').addEventListener('click',()=>play(mainId(),true));$('read-more').addEventListener('click',()=>play(moreId()));$('replay-more').addEventListener('click',()=>play(moreId(),true));$('audio-speed').addEventListener('change',()=>{if(audio)audio.playbackRate=Number($('audio-speed').value);});$('explain-more').addEventListener('toggle',()=>{if(!$('explain-more').open&&activeClip===moreId()){stopAudio();audioMessage('Explanation closed. Reading stopped.');}});
 function setCompletion(yes){readCompletion();if(yes)completed[String(MODULE)]={viewedAt:new Date().toISOString()};else delete completed[String(MODULE)];try{localStorage.setItem(COMPLETE_KEY,JSON.stringify({version:1,completed}));}catch{storage=false;}paintCompletion();}
 $('mark-complete').addEventListener('click',()=>setCompletion(true));$('undo-complete').addEventListener('click',()=>setCompletion(false));if(MODULE!==1)$('next-module').hidden=true;if(document.body.dataset.offline==='true'){$('catalog-link').href='https://alahmeds.com/decision-making.html';$('next-module').href='https://alahmeds.com/decision-making/module-02.html';}
 document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.altKey||event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey||event.shiftKey||$('contents-dialog').open||event.target.closest('button,a,input,select,textarea,summary,[contenteditable]'))return;if(event.key==='ArrowRight'){event.preventDefault();go(1);}if(event.key==='ArrowLeft'){event.preventDefault();go(-1);}});window.addEventListener('pagehide',stopAudio);window.addEventListener('storage',paintCompletion);render();
})();
